How Much Does It Cost to Develop a Mutual Fund Investment Portal or App?


Reapmind Innovations/ 30 April, 2025

Investing in mutual funds has become easier with digital platforms. People no longer have to rely on traditional methods that involve paperwork, physical visits, and long processing times. A well-developed mutual fund investment app simplifies the process, making investments accessible to a wider audience.

Building such a platform requires careful planning, as it involves financial transactions, compliance with regulations, and a user-friendly interface. The cost of development depends on multiple factors, including features, security, platform choice, and the development team. This guide will help you understand the key cost components and how you can optimize your budget while developing a mutual fund investment portal.

Key Factors That Determine the Development Cost

1. Features and Functionality

The functionality of your app significantly impacts the development cost. Here are some essential features that a mutual fund investment portal must include:

User Onboarding & Authentication
  • Registration via Email, Phone Number, and Social Media
  • Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) for security
  • Biometric Login (Face ID, Fingerprint)
KYC & Compliance
  • PAN & Aadhaar-based KYC Verification
  • SEBI & RBI Regulatory Compliance
  • Secure Document Uploads & Verification
Investment & Portfolio Management
  • Fund Search, Comparison & Recommendation Engine
  • SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) & Lumpsum Investment
  • Real-time Portfolio Tracking & Performance Analytics
  • Tax Reports & Capital Gains Calculation
Transaction & Payment Integration
  • UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card Payments
  • Automated Recurring Payments for SIPs
  • Payment Gateway Integration (Razorpay, PayU, etc.)
Customer Support & Notifications
  • Chatbot & Live Support Integration
  • Push Notifications, SMS, and Email Alerts
  • Personalized Investment Insights

2. Platform Choice: Web, Android, iOS, or Hybrid?

The cost of development depends on whether you build a web-based platform, a mobile app, or both. Here’s a breakdown:

  • Web-Only App: Cheaper but limited in mobile accessibility
  • Native Mobile Apps (Android & iOS): Higher cost but better performance
  • Hybrid App (React Native, Flutter): Cost-effective with a single codebase for all platforms

3. UI/UX Design Complexity

A well-designed interface improves user experience and retention. If you want a custom, visually engaging design with smooth animations, the cost will be higher.

4. Security & Compliance Costs

Since financial transactions are involved, strong security measures must be implemented:

  • End-to-End Data Encryption
  • Secure API Integrations
  • Anti-Fraud Detection & Prevention Systems
  • Regular Security Audits

5. Development Team & Technology Stack

The cost also depends on who builds the app. You can hire:

  • Freelancers: Lower cost but may lack expertise
  • In-House Developers: High cost with better control
  • Outsourced Development Agencies: Best for quality and scalability

Technology Stack Options:

  • Frontend: ReactJS, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin
  • Backend: Node.js, Python (Django), Java (Spring Boot)
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL
  • Cloud Services: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure

6. Third-Party API Costs

APIs play a key role in integrating external services such as:

  • Mutual Fund Data APIs (Morningstar, NSE, BSE, AMFI)
  • KYC APIs (Digio, Onfido)
  • Payment Gateway APIs (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe)

Estimated Cost Breakdown

Here’s an approximate development cost based on app complexity:

Complexity Estimated Cost
Basic (Web-based, Limited Features) ₹5–10 Lakhs
Mid-Level (Mobile App + Web, Essential Features) ₹10–25 Lakhs
Advanced (AI-Powered, Personalized Features) ₹25–50 Lakhs or more

Hidden Costs to Consider

Beyond development, other costs include:

  • Cloud Hosting (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
  • Legal & Compliance Fees (SEBI, RBI, AMFI regulations)
  • App Store & Play Store Listing Fees
  • Digital Marketing & User Acquisition
  • Regular Maintenance & Security Updates

Cost Optimization Strategies

If you’re working with a limited budget, here’s how you can reduce costs:

  • Build an MVP (Minimum Viable Product) first, then scale up
  • Use Pre-built APIs instead of custom integrations
  • Choose Hybrid Development to target multiple platforms with one codebase
  • Outsource Development to reliable agencies for cost-effective solutions

Why Choosing the Right Development Partner Matters

Developing a mutual fund investment app isn’t just about writing code. It requires expertise in fintech, compliance, security, and user experience. Partnering with an experienced development firm ensures your platform meets industry standards while being scalable and cost-efficient.

Conclusion

Building a mutual fund investment portal or mobile app requires a significant investment, but it offers long-term benefits. To get the best ROI, define your budget, prioritize essential features, and work with experienced developers. A well-optimized investment app can attract more users, improve investor experience, and boost customer retention.

FAQs

How long does it take to build a mutual fund investment app?

The timeline depends on the complexity and features. A basic version can take 3–4 months, while a fully-featured app may take 6–12 months or more including testing, security audits, and compliance.

Can I launch my app with limited features initially?

Yes, launching a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) is a smart strategy. Start with core features like onboarding, KYC, fund search, and investment tracking, then scale up based on user feedback and market needs.

Is it necessary to comply with SEBI and RBI regulations?

Absolutely. Compliance with SEBI and RBI guidelines is mandatory in India. These ensure legal operations, user data safety, and secure financial transactions.

Do I need to partner with AMCs (Asset Management Companies) to offer mutual funds?

Yes. You need to integrate with AMCs either directly or via B2B APIs from platforms like NSE, BSE, or MF Utility. This ensures real-time data and authorized transactions.

What are the ongoing maintenance costs after launching the app?

Ongoing costs include server hosting, security updates, bug fixes, compliance upgrades, and customer support. It typically ranges from ₹50,000 to ₹2 Lakhs/month depending on traffic and complexity.

How can I ensure the app is secure for financial transactions?

Implement end-to-end encryption, secure APIs, two-factor authentication, biometric logins, and regular audits. Choosing a fintech-specialized development partner ensures these are in place.
